newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon reiterates buy on Televisa.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon reiterates buy on Televisa.

text.p: --Salomon Brothers in New York reiterates buy rating on Televisa.
--Analyst Marla Marron says the Mexican media giant has downsized, divested and is deleveraging in "aggressive restructuring."
--"Televisa has emerged as a leaner, more flexible company, with a streamlined staff, low-cost production of programming, and an extension of debt maturities to 2003-08 from 1996-97," Marron says.
--Launch of Sky direct-to-home (DTH) television should help.
--Televisa has targeted 50 percent dollar revenue, up from current 25 percent and seven percent in 1991.
